request.query: sum of natural coefficients divided by natural parameters on Finsupp single equals n / r j

items.name: Finsupp.sum
items.type: {α : Type u_1} → {M : Type u_8} → {N : Type u_10} → [inst : Zero M] → [AddCommMonoid N] → (α →₀ M) → (α → M → N) → N

items.name: Finsupp.sum_nsmul
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {N : Type u_10} [inst : AddCommMonoid N] [inst_1 : Fintype α] (f : α →₀ ℕ) (g : α → N),
  (f.sum fun a b => b • g a) = ∑ a, f a • g a

items.name: Finsupp.univ_sum_single_apply
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_8} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_1 : Fintype α] (i : α) (m : M),
  ∑ j, (Finsupp.single i m) j = m

items.name: Finsupp.univ_sum_single
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_8} [inst : Fintype α] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] (f : α →₀ M),
  ∑ a, Finsupp.single a (f a) = f

items.name: Finsupp.sum_single
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_8} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] (f : α →₀ M), f.sum Finsupp.single = f

items.name: Finsupp.multinomial_eq
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} (f : α →₀ ℕ), f.multinomial = Nat.multinomial f.support ⇑f
